about: Scoring fixture for the evidence coach. Each case is one student response to one real task. 'expect' is what a reading teacher would want: accept (positive feedback is deserved) or withhold (it is not). 'knownLimit' marks cases the rule-based coach is known to get wrong; they are reported and do not fail the run. Written by the founder's side for development; replace and extend with real pilot responses, and have a second educator score a sample before treating these labels as ground truth. Cases with set 'audit' reproduce the November 18, 2026 audit and their valid comparisons. Cases with set 'heldout' were written before the fix was run against them and are reported separately; they are never tuned on, and a miss there is a known limit of pattern matching, not a regression.

note: The cases marked regression were held out until 2026-11-20, when an outside audit and the fix for it used them. Five are known limits of the pattern check: four wrong answers it passes and one right answer it abstains on. None of them can be labeled correct, because no written answer can. There is no held-out set at present; one must be written by someone who has not read the checker's rules and frozen before it is run.
